floatInfo.Description_EN: Black lacquer palace-style body with vivid carvings; 14.5 m with its parasol (pulled without it).
floatInfo.Highlight_EN: Always first in line - the honour of reaching the Otabisho first every year.
floatInfo.Source: Mapple (mapple.net/article/113868); All About; Chichibu City timetable (order)

floatInfo.Description_EN: The largest kasaboko in Chichibu: 15.5 m and about 20 t with its parasol (pulled without it).
floatInfo.Highlight_EN: The giant - overhead wires are cut away so it can pass.
floatInfo.Source: Mapple (mapple.net/article/113868); All About; Chichibu City timetable (order)

floatInfo.Description_EN: Said to be the oldest Chichibu yatai; a clean roof without a stair rail. Rear curtain: the mythical Shojo.
floatInfo.Highlight_EN: 2026 duty town for the float kabuki (in the shrine grounds).
floatInfo.Source: Mapple (mapple.net/article/113868); All About; Chichibu City timetable (order)

floatInfo.Description_EN: The biggest roof of the four yatai. Rear curtain: carp climbing a waterfall; peony & lion valance.
floatInfo.Highlight_EN: Biggest roof of the four yatai.
floatInfo.Source: Mapple (mapple.net/article/113868); All About; Chichibu City timetable (order)

floatInfo.Description_EN: A huge 'oni-ita' ridge carving of Japanese myth; sea-fish rear curtain and a turtle valance.
floatInfo.Highlight_EN: Look up at the giant ridge carving.
floatInfo.Source: Mapple (mapple.net/article/113868); All About; Chichibu City timetable (order)

floatInfo.Description_EN: Barrel-vaulted roof covered in carvings; Daruma embroidered on the rear curtain.
floatInfo.Source: Mapple (mapple.net/article/113868); All About; Chichibu City timetable (order)
